description: This file defines the SNMigrationService class, which manages multi-stage application migrations, including initialization, handling application stages and events, and version management.

classes.name: SNMigrationService
classes.description: A service class that orchestrates multi-stage migrations during app lifecycle, handling version checks, migration execution, and application events.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the service, resets references, and clears active migrations.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the migration service, runs base migration pre-run, determines required migrations, and sets up active migrations.

methods.name: markMigrationsAsDone
methods.description: Marks current migrations as completed by updating storage.

methods.name: runBaseMigrationPreRun
methods.description: Creates and runs pre-migration setup via BaseMigration.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Handles application stage changes, delegating to base migration and internal handling.

methods.name: handleApplicationEvent
methods.description: Responds to application events, e.g., sign-in, to trigger stage handling.

methods.name: hasPendingMigrations
methods.description: Checks if there are pending migrations or keychain repairs needed.

methods.name: getStoredSnjsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the stored SNJS version from device storage, throws error if missing.

methods.name: getRequiredMigrations
methods.description: Determines which migration classes are required based on stored version.

methods.name: handleStage
methods.description: Handles a specific application stage, delegating to base and active migrations.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic info about active migrations.
